headline: Sellers Drive Bitcoin Volume Delta To A 30-Day Extreme
narrative: Bitcoin's cumulative volume delta printed -1,177.059, the 0.0 percentile of the past 30 days. That pipe compares aggressive selling with aggressive buying, and a reading at the bottom of the range means sellers are firmly in control. Coins are being sold into the bid near 78k rather than lifted by new buyers.
author: jordan
